text:
88. Research has shown that due to the difficulties courts face in obtaining full and accurate
information about defendants’ needs, there is significant overuse of custodial remand for the
purpose of facilitating psychiatric assessments.
165

89. Prison can be wrongly viewed as a speedy and reliable place of safety for vulnerable
individuals. L&D Services should be able to help obtain timely information about defendants’
support needs, including referrals for support while defendants await subsequent court
appearances.

90. Where bail is granted subject to residence at “approved premises”, these need to be suitable
for the particular defendant.

164 “Inclusive justice: a system designed for all. Findings and recommendations”: EHRC (June 2020).

165 For a discussion of this, see “Mental health and learning disabilities in the criminal courts: Information for
magistrates, district judges and court staff”: McConnell and Talbot, The Prison Reform Trust and Rethink Mental
Illness (2013).
